editorial_note: Opening hook 'Your API request costs 1 token. No tokens, no entry.' was chosen by the owner. It is one step more general than the sources (true of token bucket APIs); scene 3 scopes it to Stripe's token bucket and 'entry' is figurative for the source word 'reject'.

share.who: a developer whose script keeps getting a 429 response
share.why: it tells them what to do next: look for a Retry-After header that says how long to wait

replay.twist: On a second watch 'No tokens, no entry' reads as 'no entry yet': the last line says it only lasts until the bucket refills.

length_reason: About 143 words (49 s): the worked example (3 tokens, 4 requests) needs its own beat so the refill payoff lands.
